  "content": "\"\"\"\nTask processing and generation execution.\n\nContains the core logic for processing a single generation task\n(``process_task_impl``) and delegating the actual generation to\nheadless_wgp.py via the orchestrator (``execute_generation_impl``).\n\nEvery public function takes the ``HeadlessTaskQueue`` instance\n(aliased *queue*) as its first argument.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport os\nimport time\nimport traceback\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import TYPE_CHECKING\n\nif TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from headless_model_management import HeadlessTaskQueue, GenerationTask\n\n# Import debug print function from worker\ntry:\n    from worker import dprint\nexcept ImportError:\n    from source.core.log import headless_logger as _fallback_logger\n    def dprint(msg):\n        if os.environ.get('DEBUG'):\n            _fallback_logger.debug(msg)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Task processing\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef process_task_impl(queue: \"HeadlessTaskQueue\", task: \"GenerationTask\", worker_name: str):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single generation task.\n\n    This is where we delegate to headless_wgp.py while managing\n    model persistence and state.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Ensure logs emitted during this generation are attributed to this task.\n    # This runs inside the GenerationWorker thread, which is where wgp/headless_wgp runs.\n    try:\n        from source.core.log import set_current_task_context  # local import to avoid cycles\n        set_current_task_context(task.id)\n    except (ImportError, AttributeError, TypeError) as e:\n        logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue').debug(f\"Failed to set task logging context for {task.id}: {e}\")\n\n    with queue.queue_lock:\n        queue.current_task = task\n        task.status = \"processing\"\n\n    queue.logger.info(f\"{worker_name} processing task {task.id}\")\n    start_time = time.time()\n\n    try:\n        # 1. Ensure correct model is loaded (orchestrator checks WGP's ground truth)\n        queue._switch_model(task.model, worker_name)\n\n        # 2. Reset billing start time now that model is loaded\n        # This ensures users aren't charged for model loading time\n        try:\n            from source.db_operations import reset_generation_started_at\n            reset_generation_started_at(task.id)\n        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e_billing:\n            # Don't fail the task if billing reset fails - just log it\n            queue.logger.warning(f\"[BILLING] Failed to reset generation_started_at for task {task.id}: {e_billing}\")\n\n        # 3. Delegate actual generation to orchestrator\n        # The orchestrator handles the heavy lifting while we manage the queue\n        result_path = queue._execute_generation(task, worker_name)\n\n        # Verify we're still in Wan2GP directory after generation\n        current_dir = os.getcwd()\n        if \"Wan2GP\" not in current_dir:\n            queue.logger.warning(\n                f\"[PATH_CHECK] After generation: Current directory changed!\\n\"\n                f\"  Current: {current_dir}\\n\"\n                f\"  Expected: Should contain 'Wan2GP'\\n\"\n                f\"  This may cause issues for subsequent tasks!\"\n            )\n        else:\n            queue.logger.debug(f\"[PATH_CHECK] After generation: Still in Wan2GP\")\n\n        # 3. Validate output and update task status\n        processing_time = time.time() - start_time\n        is_success = bool(result_path)\n        try:\n            if is_success:\n                # If a path was returned, check existence where possible\n                rp = Path(result_path)\n                is_success = rp.exists()\n\n                # Some environments (e.g. networked volumes) can briefly report a freshly-written file as missing.\n                # Do a short retry before failing the task.\n                if not is_success:\n                    try:\n                        # Note: os is imported at module level - don't re-import here as it causes\n                        # \"local variable 'os' referenced before assignment\" due to Python scoping\n                        import time as _time\n\n                        retry_s = 2.0\n                        interval_s = 0.2\n                        attempts = max(1, int(retry_s / interval_s))\n\n                        for _ in range(attempts):\n                            _time.sleep(interval_s)\n                            if rp.exists():\n                                is_success = True\n                                break\n\n                        if not is_success:\n                            # Tagged diagnostics to debug \"phantom output path\" failures\n                            # Keep output bounded to avoid log spam.\n                            tag = \"[TravelNoOutputGenerated]\"\n                            cwd = os.getcwd()\n                            parent = rp.parent\n                            queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Output path missing after generation: {result_path}\")\n                            queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} CWD: {cwd}\")\n                            try:\n                                queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Parent exists: {parent} -> {parent.exists()}\")\n                            except OSError as _e:\n                                queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Parent exists check failed: {type(_e).__name__}: {_e}\")\n\n                            try:\n                                if parent.exists():\n                                    # Show a small sample of directory contents to spot mismatched output dirs.\n                                    entries = sorted([p.name for p in parent.iterdir()])[:50]\n                                    queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Parent dir sample (first {len(entries)}): {entries}\")\n                            except OSError as _e:\n                                queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Parent list failed: {type(_e).__name__}: {_e}\")\n\n                            # Common alternative location when running from Wan2GP/ with relative outputs\n                            try:\n                                alt_parent = Path(cwd) / \"outputs\"\n                                if alt_parent != parent and alt_parent.exists():\n                                    alt_entries = sorted([p.name for p in alt_parent.iterdir()])[:50]\n                                    queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Alt outputs dir: {alt_parent} sample (first {len(alt_entries)}): {alt_entries}\")\n                            except OSError as _e:\n                                queue.logger.error(f\"{tag} Alt outputs list failed: {type(_e).__name__}: {_e}\")\n                    except OSError:\n                        # Never let diagnostics break the worker loop.\n                        pass\n        except OSError:\n            # If any exception while checking, keep prior truthiness\n            pass\n\n        with queue.queue_lock:\n            task.processing_time = processing_time\n            if is_success:\n                task.status = \"completed\"\n                task.result_path = result_path\n                queue.stats[\"tasks_completed\"] += 1\n                queue.stats[\"total_generation_time\"] += processing_time\n                queue.logger.info(f\"Task {task.id} completed in {processing_time:.1f}s: {result_path}\")\n            else:\n                task.status = \"failed\"\n                task.error_message = \"No output generated\"\n                queue.stats[\"tasks_failed\"] += 1\n                queue.logger.error(f\"Task {task.id} failed after {processing_time:.1f}s: No output generated\")\n\n        # Memory cleanup after each task (does NOT unload models)\n        # This clears PyTorch's internal caches and Python garbage to prevent fragmentation\n        queue._cleanup_memory_after_task(task.id)\n\n    except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:\n        # Handle task failure\n        processing_time = time.time() - start_time\n        error_message_str = str(e)\n\n        with queue.queue_lock:\n            task.status = \"failed\"\n            task.error_message = error_message_str\n            task.processing_time = processing_time\n            queue.stats[\"tasks_failed\"] += 1\n\n        queue.logger.error(f\"Task {task.id} failed after {processing_time:.1f}s: {e}\")\n\n        # Check if this is a fatal error that requires worker termination\n        try:\n            from source.task_handlers.worker.fatal_error_handler import check_and_handle_fatal_error, FatalWorkerError\n            check_and_handle_fatal_error(\n                error_message=error_message_str,\n                exception=e,\n                logger=queue.logger,\n                worker_id=os.getenv(\"WORKER_ID\"),\n                task_id=task.id\n            )\n        except FatalWorkerError:\n            # Re-raise fatal errors to propagate to main worker loop\n            raise\n        except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError, ImportError) as fatal_check_error:\n            # If fatal error checking itself fails, log but don't crash\n            queue.logger.error(f\"Error checking for fatal errors: {fatal_check_error}\")\n\n    finally:\n        with queue.queue_lock:\n            queue.current_task = None\n        try:\n            from source.core.log import set_current_task_context  # local import to avoid cycles\n            set_current_task_context(None)\n        except (ImportError, AttributeError, TypeError) as e:\n            logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue').debug(f\"Failed to clear task logging context: {e}\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Generation execution\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef execute_generation_impl(queue: \"HeadlessTaskQueue\", task: \"GenerationTask\", worker_name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"\n    Execute the actual generation using headless_wgp.py.\n\n    This delegates to the orchestrator while providing progress tracking\n    and integration with our queue system. Enhanced to support video guides,\n    masks, image references, and other advanced features.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Ensure orchestrator is initialized before generation\n    queue._ensure_orchestrator()\n\n    queue.logger.info(f\"{worker_name} executing generation for task {task.id} (model: {task.model})\")\n\n    # Convert task parameters to WanOrchestrator format\n    wgp_params = queue._convert_to_wgp_task(task)\n\n    # Remove model and prompt from params since they're passed separately to avoid duplication\n    generation_params = {k: v for k, v in wgp_params.items() if k not in (\"model\", \"prompt\")}\n\n    # DEBUG: Log all parameter keys to verify _parsed_phase_config is present\n    queue.logger.info(f\"[PHASE_CONFIG_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: generation_params keys: {list(generation_params.keys())}\")\n\n    # CRITICAL: Apply phase_config patches NOW in the worker thread where wgp is imported\n    # Store patch info for cleanup in finally block\n    _patch_applied = False\n    _parsed_phase_config_for_restore = None\n    _model_name_for_restore = None\n\n    if \"_parsed_phase_config\" in generation_params and \"_phase_config_model_name\" in generation_params:\n        parsed_phase_config = generation_params.pop(\"_parsed_phase_config\")\n        model_name = generation_params.pop(\"_phase_config_model_name\")\n\n        # Save for restoration\n        _parsed_phase_config_for_restore = parsed_phase_config\n        _model_name_for_restore = model_name\n\n        queue.logger.info(f\"[PHASE_CONFIG] Applying model patch in GenerationWorker for '{model_name}'\")\n\n        from source.core.params.phase_config import apply_phase_config_patch\n        apply_phase_config_patch(parsed_phase_config, model_name, task.id)\n        _patch_applied = True\n\n    # Handle svi2pro: This is a model_def property, not a generate() parameter\n    # We need to patch it into BOTH wgp.models_def AND wan_model.model_def\n    # because the model captures model_def at load time, not at generation time\n    _svi2pro_original = None\n    _svi2pro_patched = False\n    _wan_model_patched = False\n    if generation_params.get(\"svi2pro\"):\n        try:\n            import wgp\n            model_key = task.model\n\n            # Patch 1: wgp.models_def (for any new model loads)\n            if model_key in wgp.models_def:\n                _svi2pro_original = wgp.models_def[model_key].get(\"svi2pro\")\n                wgp.models_def[model_key][\"svi2pro\"] = True\n                _svi2pro_patched = True\n                queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO] Patched wgp.models_def['{model_key}']['svi2pro'] = True (was: {_svi2pro_original})\", task_id=task.id)\n\n            # Patch 2: wan_model.model_def DIRECTLY (the actual object used during generation)\n            # This is critical because the model was loaded BEFORE we patched models_def\n            if hasattr(wgp, 'wan_model') and wgp.wan_model is not None:\n                if hasattr(wgp.wan_model, 'model_def') and wgp.wan_model.model_def is not None:\n                    # Diagnostic: check if they're the same object\n                    models_def_obj = wgp.models_def.get(model_key)\n                    wan_model_def_obj = wgp.wan_model.model_def\n                    same_object = models_def_obj is wan_model_def_obj\n                    queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO_DIAG] models_def['{model_key}'] id={id(models_def_obj)}, wan_model.model_def id={id(wan_model_def_obj)}, same_object={same_object}\", task_id=task.id)\n\n                    # Patch svi2pro\n                    wgp.wan_model.model_def[\"svi2pro\"] = True\n\n                    # CRITICAL: Also patch sliding_window=True - required for video continuation\n                    # Without this, reuse_frames=0 and video_source context is ignored\n                    _sliding_window_original = wgp.wan_model.model_def.get(\"sliding_window\")\n                    wgp.wan_model.model_def[\"sliding_window\"] = True\n\n                    # CRITICAL: Patch sliding_window_defaults to bypass WGP's latent alignment formula\n                    # Without this, sliding_window_overlap=4 becomes 1 via: (4-1)//4*4+1 = 1\n                    # The original SVI model has overlap_default=4, which makes the formula skip\n                    wgp.wan_model.model_def[\"sliding_window_defaults\"] = {\"overlap_default\": 4}\n\n                    # CRITICAL: In the kijai-style SVI+end-frame pixel concatenation path, the middle frames\n                    # are initialized as zeros before VAE encode (matching kijai and original Wan2GP).\n                    # Use zeros for empty frames (standard approach, matching kijai)\n                    wgp.wan_model.model_def[\"svi_empty_frames_mode\"] = \"zeros\"\n\n                    # Also patch wgp.models_def for consistency (this is what test_any_sliding_window reads!)\n                    if model_key in wgp.models_def:\n                        _sw_before = wgp.models_def[model_key].get(\"sliding_window\", \"NOT_SET\")\n                        wgp.models_def[model_key][\"sliding_window\"] = True\n                        wgp.models_def[model_key][\"sliding_window_defaults\"] = {\"overlap_default\": 4}\n                        wgp.models_def[model_key][\"svi_empty_frames_mode\"] = \"zeros\"\n                        queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO] Patched wgp.models_def['{model_key}']['sliding_window'] = True (was: {_sw_before})\", task_id=task.id)\n\n                    _wan_model_patched = True\n\n                    # Verify the patches took effect\n                    verify_svi2pro = wgp.wan_model.model_def.get(\"svi2pro\")\n                    verify_sliding = wgp.wan_model.model_def.get(\"sliding_window\")\n                    verify_defaults = wgp.wan_model.model_def.get(\"sliding_window_defaults\")\n                    queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO] Patched wan_model.model_def: svi2pro={verify_svi2pro}, sliding_window={verify_sliding}, sliding_window_defaults={verify_defaults} (was: {_sliding_window_original})\", task_id=task.id)\n                else:\n                    queue.logger.warning(f\"[SVI2PRO] wan_model exists but has no model_def\", task_id=task.id)\n            else:\n                queue.logger.warning(f\"[SVI2PRO] wgp.wan_model not found - model may not be loaded yet\", task_id=task.id)\n\n        except (RuntimeError, AttributeError, ImportError, KeyError) as e:\n            queue.logger.warning(f\"[SVI2PRO] Failed to patch svi2pro: {e}\", task_id=task.id)\n        # Remove from generation_params since it's not a generate() parameter\n        generation_params.pop(\"svi2pro\", None)\n\n    # Log generation parameters for debugging\n    dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: Generation parameters:\")\n    for key, value in generation_params.items():\n        if key in [\"video_guide\", \"video_mask\", \"image_refs\"]:\n            dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG]   {key}: {value}\")\n        elif key in [\"video_length\", \"resolution\", \"num_inference_steps\"]:\n            dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG]   {key}: {value}\")\n\n    # Determine generation type and delegate - wrap in try/finally for patch restoration\n    try:\n        # Check if model supports VACE features\n        model_supports_vace = queue._model_supports_vace(task.model)\n\n        if model_supports_vace:\n            dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: Using VACE generation path\")\n\n            # CRITICAL: VACE models require a video_guide parameter\n            if \"video_guide\" in generation_params and generation_params[\"video_guide\"]:\n                dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: Video guide provided: {generation_params['video_guide']}\")\n            else:\n                error_msg = f\"VACE model '{task.model}' requires a video_guide parameter but none was provided. VACE models cannot perform pure text-to-video generation.\"\n                queue.logger.error(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: {error_msg}\")\n                raise ValueError(error_msg)\n\n            result = queue.orchestrator.generate_vace(\n                prompt=task.prompt,\n                model_type=task.model,  # Pass model type for parameter resolution\n                **generation_params\n            )\n        elif queue.orchestrator._is_flux():\n            dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: Using Flux generation path\")\n\n            # For Flux, map video_length to num_images\n            if \"video_length\" in generation_params:\n                generation_params[\"num_images\"] = generation_params.pop(\"video_length\")\n\n            result = queue.orchestrator.generate_flux(\n                prompt=task.prompt,\n                model_type=task.model,  # Pass model type for parameter resolution\n                **generation_params\n            )\n        else:\n            dprint(f\"[GENERATION_DEBUG] Task {task.id}: Using T2V generation path\")\n\n            # T2V or other models - pass model_type for proper parameter resolution\n            # Note: WGP stdout is captured to svi_debug.txt file instead of logger\n            # to avoid recursion issues\n            result = queue.orchestrator.generate_t2v(\n                prompt=task.prompt,\n                model_type=task.model,  # CRITICAL: Pass model type for parameter resolution\n                **generation_params\n            )\n\n        queue.logger.info(f\"{worker_name} generation completed for task {task.id}: {result}\")\n\n        # Post-process single frame videos to PNG for single_image tasks\n        # BUT: Skip PNG conversion for travel segments (they must remain as videos for stitching)\n        is_travel_segment = task.parameters.get(\"_source_task_type\") == \"travel_segment\"\n        if queue._is_single_image_task(task) and not is_travel_segment:\n            png_result = queue._convert_single_frame_video_to_png(task, result, worker_name)\n            if png_result:\n                queue.logger.info(f\"{worker_name} converted single frame video to PNG: {png_result}\")\n                return png_result\n\n        return result\n\n    except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:\n        queue.logger.error(f\"{worker_name} generation failed for task {task.id}: {e}\")\n        raise\n    finally:\n        # CRITICAL: Restore model patches to prevent contamination across tasks\n        if _patch_applied and _parsed_phase_config_for_restore and _model_name_for_restore:\n            try:\n                from source.core.params.phase_config import restore_model_patches\n                restore_model_patches(\n                    _parsed_phase_config_for_restore,\n                    _model_name_for_restore,\n                    task.id\n                )\n                queue.logger.info(f\"[PHASE_CONFIG] Restored original model definition for '{_model_name_for_restore}' after task {task.id}\")\n            except (RuntimeError, ImportError, OSError) as restore_error:\n                queue.logger.warning(f\"[PHASE_CONFIG] Failed to restore model patches for task {task.id}: {restore_error}\")\n\n        # Restore svi2pro and sliding_window if we patched them\n        if _svi2pro_patched or _wan_model_patched:\n            try:\n                import wgp\n                model_key = task.model\n\n                # Restore wgp.models_def\n                if _svi2pro_patched and model_key in wgp.models_def:\n                    if _svi2pro_original is None:\n                        wgp.models_def[model_key].pop(\"svi2pro\", None)\n                    else:\n                        wgp.models_def[model_key][\"svi2pro\"] = _svi2pro_original\n                    # Also restore sliding_window\n                    wgp.models_def[model_key].pop(\"sliding_window\", None)\n                    queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO] Restored wgp.models_def['{model_key}']['svi2pro'] to {_svi2pro_original}\", task_id=task.id)\n\n                # Restore wan_model.model_def\n                if _wan_model_patched and hasattr(wgp, 'wan_model') and wgp.wan_model is not None:\n                    if hasattr(wgp.wan_model, 'model_def') and wgp.wan_model.model_def is not None:\n                        if _svi2pro_original is None:\n                            wgp.wan_model.model_def.pop(\"svi2pro\", None)\n                        else:\n                            wgp.wan_model.model_def[\"svi2pro\"] = _svi2pro_original\n                        # Also restore sliding_window\n                        wgp.wan_model.model_def.pop(\"sliding_window\", None)\n                        queue.logger.info(f\"[SVI2PRO] Restored wan_model.model_def: svi2pro={_svi2pro_original}, sliding_window=removed\", task_id=task.id)\n\n            except (RuntimeError, ImportError, AttributeError, KeyError) as restore_error:\n                queue.logger.warning(f\"[SVI2PRO] Failed to restore svi2pro for task {task.id}: {restore_error}\")\n"

   100→class HeadlessTaskQueue(WgpInitMixin, QueueStateMixin):
   101→    """
   102→    Main task queue manager that integrates with wgp.py's existing queue system.
   103→
   104→    This class leverages wgp.py's built-in task management and state persistence
   105→    while providing a clean API for headless operation.
   106→
   107→    Mixins:
   108→        WgpInitMixin: CUDA warmup and lazy WanOrchestrator initialization
   109→        QueueStateMixin: Task status queries, wait-for-completion, queue status snapshots
   110→    """
   111→    
   112→    def __init__(self, wan_dir: str, max_workers: int = 1, debug_mode: bool = False, main_output_dir: Optional[str] = None):
   113→        """
   114→        Initialize the headless task queue.
   115→
   116→        Args:
   117→            wan_dir: Path to WanGP directory
   118→            max_workers: Number of concurrent generation workers (recommend 1 for GPU)
   119→            debug_mode: Enable verbose debug logging (should match worker's --debug flag)
   120→            main_output_dir: Optional path for output directory. If not provided, defaults to
   121→                           'outputs' directory next to wan_dir (preserves backwards compatibility)
   122→        """
   123→        self.wan_dir = setup_wgp_path(wan_dir)
   124→        self.max_workers = max_workers
   125→        self.main_output_dir = main_output_dir
   126→        self.running = False
   127→        self.start_time = time.time()
   128→        self.debug_mode = debug_mode  # Now controlled by caller
   129→        
   130→        # Import wgp after path setup (protect sys.argv to prevent argument conflicts)
   131→        _saved_argv = sys.argv[:]
   132→        sys.argv = ["headless_wgp.py"]
   133→        # Headless stubs to avoid optional UI deps (tkinter/matanyone) during import
   134→        try:
   135→            import types
   136→            # Stub tkinter if not available
   137→            if 'tkinter' not in sys.modules:
   138→                sys.modules['tkinter'] = types.ModuleType('tkinter')
   139→            # Stub preprocessing.matanyone.app with minimal interface
   140→            dummy_pkg = types.ModuleType('preprocessing')
   141→            dummy_matanyone = types.ModuleType('preprocessing.matanyone')
   142→            dummy_app = types.ModuleType('preprocessing.matanyone.app')
   143→            def _noop_handler():
   144→                class _Dummy:
   145→                    def __getattr__(self, _):
   146→                        return None
   147→                return _Dummy()
   148→            dummy_app.get_vmc_event_handler = _noop_handler  # type: ignore
   149→            sys.modules['preprocessing'] = dummy_pkg
   150→            sys.modules['preprocessing.matanyone'] = dummy_matanyone
   151→            sys.modules['preprocessing.matanyone.app'] = dummy_app
   152→        except (TypeError, AttributeError, ImportError) as e:
   153→            logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue').debug(f"Failed to set up headless UI stubs: {e}")
   154→        # Don't import wgp during initialization to avoid CUDA/argparse conflicts
   155→        # wgp will be imported lazily when needed (e.g., in _apply_sampler_cfg_preset)
   156→        # This allows the queue to initialize even if CUDA isn't ready yet
   157→        self.wgp = None
   158→        
   159→        # Restore sys.argv immediately (no wgp import, so no need for protection)
   160→        try:
   161→            sys.argv = _saved_argv
   162→        except (TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
   163→            logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue').debug(f"Failed to restore sys.argv after init: {e}")
   164→        
   165→        # Defer orchestrator initialization to avoid CUDA init during queue setup
   166→        # Orchestrator imports wgp, which triggers deep imports that call torch.cuda
   167→        # We'll initialize it lazily when first needed
   168→        self.orchestrator = None
   169→        self._orchestrator_init_attempted = False
   170→        logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue').info(f"HeadlessTaskQueue created (orchestrator will initialize on first use)")
   171→        
   172→        # Task management
   173→        self.task_queue = queue.PriorityQueue()
   174→        self.task_history: Dict[str, GenerationTask] = {}
   175→        self.current_task: Optional[GenerationTask] = None
   176→        self.current_model: Optional[str] = None
   177→        
   178→        # Threading
   179→        self.worker_threads: List[threading.Thread] = []
   180→        self.queue_lock = threading.RLock()
   181→        self.shutdown_event = threading.Event()
   182→        
   183→        # Statistics
   184→        self.stats = {
   185→            "tasks_submitted": 0,
   186→            "tasks_completed": 0,
   187→            "tasks_failed": 0,
   188→            "model_switches": 0,
   189→            "total_generation_time": 0.0
   190→        }
   191→        
   192→        # Setup logging
   193→        self._setup_logging()
   194→        
   195→        # Initialize wgp state (reuse existing state management)
   196→        self._init_wgp_integration()
   197→        
   198→        self.logger.info(f"HeadlessTaskQueue initialized with WanGP at {wan_dir}")
   199→    
   200→    def _setup_logging(self):
   201→        """Setup structured logging that goes to Supabase via the log interceptor."""
   202→        # Keep Python's basic logging for local file backup
   203→        logging.basicConfig(
   204→            level=logging.INFO,
   205→            format='%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s',
   206→            handlers=[
   207→                logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout),
   208→                logging.FileHandler('headless.log')
   209→            ]
   210→        )
   211→        self._file_logger = logging.getLogger('HeadlessQueue')
   212→        
   213→        # Use queue_logger (ComponentLogger) as main logger - this goes to Supabase
   214→        # ComponentLogger has compatible interface: .info(), .error(), .warning(), .debug()
   215→        self.logger = queue_logger

   249→    def _model_supports_vace(self, model_key: str) -> bool:
   250→        """
   251→        Check if a model supports VACE features (video guides, masks, etc.).
   252→        """
   253→        # Ensure orchestrator is initialized before checking model support
   254→        self._ensure_orchestrator()
   255→        
   256→        try:
   257→            # Use orchestrator's VACE detection with model key
   258→            if hasattr(self.orchestrator, 'is_model_vace'):
   259→                return self.orchestrator.is_model_vace(model_key)
   260→            elif hasattr(self.orchestrator, '_is_vace'):
   261→                # Fallback: load model and check (less efficient)
   262→                current_model = self.current_model
   263→                if current_model != model_key:
   264→                    # Would need to load model to check - use name-based detection as fallback
   265→                    return "vace" in model_key.lower()
   266→                return self.orchestrator._is_vace()
   267→            else:
   268→                # Ultimate fallback: name-based detection
   269→                return "vace" in model_key.lower()
   270→        except (AttributeError, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
   271→            self.logger.warning(f"Could not determine VACE support for model '{model_key}': {e}")
   272→            return "vace" in model_key.lower()
   273→    
   274→    def _is_single_image_task(self, task: GenerationTask) -> bool:
   275→        """
   276→        Check if this is a single image task that should be converted from video to PNG.
   277→        """
   278→        # Check if video_length is 1 (single frame) and this looks like an image task
   279→        video_length = task.parameters.get("video_length", 0)
   280→        return video_length == 1
   281→    
   282→    def _convert_single_frame_video_to_png(self, task: GenerationTask, video_path: str, worker_name: str) -> str:
   283→        """
   284→        Convert a single-frame video to PNG format for single image tasks.
   285→        
   286→        This restores the functionality that was in the original single_image.py handler
   287→        where single-frame videos were converted to PNG files.
   288→        """
   289→        try:
   290→            import cv2
   291→            
   292→            video_path_obj = Path(video_path)
   293→            if not video_path_obj.exists():
   294→                self.logger.error(f"Video file does not exist for PNG conversion: {video_path}")
   295→                return video_path  # Return original path if conversion fails
   296→            
   297→            # Create PNG output path with sanitized filename to prevent upload issues
   298→            original_filename = video_path_obj.stem
   299→            
   300→            # Sanitize the filename for storage compatibility
   301→            try:
   302→                from source.utils import sanitize_filename_for_storage
   303→
   304→                sanitized_filename = sanitize_filename_for_storage(original_filename)
   305→                if not sanitized_filename:
   306→                    sanitized_filename = "generated_image"
   307→
   308→            except ImportError:
   309→                # Fallback sanitization if import fails
   310→                import re
   311→                sanitized_filename = re.sub(r'[§®©™@·º½¾¿¡~\x00-\x1F\x7F-\x9F<>:"/\\|?*,]', '', original_filename)
   312→                sanitized_filename = re.sub(r'\s+', '_', sanitized_filename.strip())
   313→                if not sanitized_filename:
   314→                    sanitized_filename = "generated_image"
   315→            
   316→            # Create PNG path with sanitized filename
   317→            png_path = video_path_obj.parent / f"{sanitized_filename}.png"
   318→            
   319→            # Log sanitization if filename changed
   320→            if sanitized_filename != original_filename:
   321→                self.logger.info(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Sanitized filename '{original_filename}' -> '{sanitized_filename}'")
   322→            
   323→            self.logger.info(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Converting {video_path_obj.name} to {png_path.name}")
   324→            
   325→            # Extract the first frame using OpenCV
   326→            cap = cv2.VideoCapture(str(video_path_obj))
   327→            try:
   328→                if cap.isOpened():
   329→                    ret, frame = cap.read()
   330→                    if ret:
   331→                        # Save the frame as PNG
   332→                        success = cv2.imwrite(str(png_path), frame)
   333→                        if success and png_path.exists():
   334→                            self.logger.info(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Successfully saved PNG to {png_path}")
   335→                            
   336→                            # Clean up the original video file
   337→                            try:
   338→                                video_path_obj.unlink()
   339→                                self.logger.info(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Removed original video file")
   340→                            except OSError as e_cleanup:
   341→                                self.logger.warning(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Could not remove original video: {e_cleanup}")
   342→                            
   343→                            return str(png_path)
   344→                        else:
   345→                            self.logger.error(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Failed to save PNG to {png_path}")
   346→                    else:
   347→                        self.logger.error(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Failed to read frame from video")
   348→                else:
   349→                    self.logger.error(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Failed to open video file")
   350→            finally:
   351→                cap.release()
   352→                
   353→        except ImportError:
   354→            self.logger.warning(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: OpenCV not available, keeping video format")
   355→        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
   356→            self.logger.error(f"[PNG_CONVERSION] Task {task.id}: Error during conversion: {e}")
   357→        
   358→        # Return original video path if conversion failed
   359→        return video_path

   370→    def _apply_sampler_cfg_preset(self, model_key: str, sample_solver: str, wgp_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   371→        """Apply sampler-specific CFG and flow_shift settings from model configuration."""
   372→        try:
   373→            # Import WGP to get model definition
   374→            # Protect sys.argv in case wgp hasn't been imported yet
   375→            _saved_argv = sys.argv[:]
   376→            try:
   377→                sys.argv = ["headless_model_management.py"]
   378→                import wgp
   379→            finally:
   380→                sys.argv = _saved_argv
   381→
   382→            model_def = wgp.get_model_def(model_key)
   383→            
   384→            # Check if model has sampler-specific presets
   385→            sampler_presets = model_def.get("sampler_cfg_presets", {})
   386→            if sample_solver in sampler_presets:
   387→                preset = sampler_presets[sample_solver]
   388→                
   389→                # Apply preset settings, but allow task parameters to override
   390→                applied_params = {}
   391→                for param, value in preset.items():
   392→                    if param not in wgp_params:  # Only apply if not explicitly set in task
   393→                        wgp_params[param] = value
   394→                        applied_params[param] = value
   395→                        
   396→                self.logger.info(f"Applied sampler '{sample_solver}' CFG preset: {applied_params}")
   397→            else:
   398→                self.logger.debug(f"No CFG preset found for sampler '{sample_solver}' in model '{model_key}'")
   399→                
   400→        except (ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError, TypeError, ImportError) as e:
   401→            self.logger.warning(f"Failed to apply sampler CFG preset: {e}")
   402→

   414→def main():
   415→    """Main entry point for the headless service."""
   416→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="WanGP Headless Task Queue")
   417→    parser.add_argument("--wan-dir", required=True, help="Path to WanGP directory")
   418→    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=1, help="Number of worker threads")
   419→    parser.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true", help="Enable debug logging")
   420→
   421→    args = parser.parse_args()
   422→
   423→    if args.debug:
   424→        logging.getLogger().setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
   425→
   426→    # Initialize queue
   427→    task_queue = HeadlessTaskQueue(args.wan_dir, max_workers=args.workers)
   428→
   429→    # Setup signal handlers
   430→    def signal_handler(signum, frame):
   431→        queue_logger.essential("Received shutdown signal, stopping...")
   432→        task_queue.stop()
   433→        sys.exit(0)
   434→
   435→    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
   436→    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
   437→
   438→    try:
   439→        # Start services
   440→        task_queue.start()
   441→
   442→        queue_logger.essential(f"Headless queue started")
   443→        queue_logger.essential(f"WanGP directory: {args.wan_dir}")
   444→        queue_logger.essential(f"Workers: {args.workers}")
   445→        queue_logger.essential("Press Ctrl+C to stop...")
   446→
   447→        # Example: Submit some test tasks
   448→        if args.debug:
   449→            queue_logger.debug("Submitting test tasks...")
   450→
   451→            # Test T2V task
   452→            t2v_task = create_sample_task(
   453→                "test-t2v-1",
   454→                "t2v",
   455→                "a mystical forest with glowing trees",
   456→                resolution="1280x720",
   457→                video_length=49,
   458→                seed=42
   459→            )
   460→            task_queue.submit_task(t2v_task)
   461→
   462→        # Keep running until shutdown
   463→        while task_queue.running:
   464→            time.sleep(1.0)
   465→
   466→            # Print periodic status
   467→            if args.debug:
   468→                status = task_queue.get_queue_status()
   469→                queue_logger.debug(f"Queue: {status.pending_tasks} pending, "
   470→                      f"{status.completed_tasks} completed, "
   471→                      f"{status.failed_tasks} failed")
   472→
   473→    except KeyboardInterrupt:
   474→        queue_logger.essential("Shutdown requested by user")
   475→    except Exception as e:
   476→        queue_logger.error(f"Fatal error: {e}")
   477→        raise
   478→    finally:
   479→        task_queue.stop()
   480→
   481→
   482→if __name__ == "__main__":
   483→    main()
   484→

     2→Queue state tracking mixin for HeadlessTaskQueue.
     3→
     4→Handles task status queries, wait-for-completion, queue status snapshots,
     5→and memory usage reporting. Separated from the main queue coordinator
     6→to isolate read-only state inspection from coordination logic.
     7→"""

     9→from __future__ import annotations
    10→
    11→import time

    18→class QueueStateMixin:
    19→    """Mixin providing queue state inspection and task status tracking."""
    20→
    21→    def get_task_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[GenerationTask]:
    22→        """Get status of a specific task."""
    23→        return self.task_history.get(task_id)
    24→
    25→    def wait_for_completion(self, task_id: str, timeout: float = 300.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    26→        """
    27→        Wait for a task to complete and return the result.
    28→
    29→        Args:
    30→            task_id: ID of the task to wait for
    31→            timeout: Maximum time to wait in seconds
    32→
    33→        Returns:
    34→            Dictionary with 'success', 'output_path', and optional 'error' keys
    35→        """
    36→        start_time = time.time()
    37→
    38→        while (time.time() - start_time) < timeout:
    39→            task_status = self.get_task_status(task_id)
    40→
    41→            if task_status is None:
    42→                return {
    43→                    "success": False,
    44→                    "error": f"Task {task_id} not found in queue"
    45→                }
    46→
    47→            if task_status.status == "completed":
    48→                return {
    49→                    "success": True,
    50→                    "output_path": task_status.result_path
    51→                }
    52→            elif task_status.status == "failed":
    53→                return {
    54→                    "success": False,
    55→                    "error": task_status.error_message or "Task failed with unknown error"
    56→                }
    57→
    58→            # Task is still pending or processing, wait a bit
    59→            time.sleep(1.0)
    60→
    61→        # Timeout reached
    62→        return {
    63→            "success": False,
    64→            "error": f"Task {task_id} did not complete within {timeout} seconds"
    65→        }
    66→

    69→        # Local import to avoid circular dependency (task_queue.py imports this mixin)

    71→
    72→        with self.queue_lock:
    73→            return QueueStatus(

    76→                completed_tasks=self.stats["tasks_completed"],

    78→                current_model=self.current_model,

   107→            config = QWEN_EDIT_MODEL_CONFIG["qwen-edit"]
   108→        return config

   135→    # ── LoRA management ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   136→
   137→    def _download_lora_if_missing(self, repo_id: str, filename: str, hf_subfolder: str = None) -> Optional[Path]:
   138→        """Helper to download a LoRA if it doesn't exist locally."""
   139→        target_path = self.qwen_lora_dir / filename
   140→        if target_path.exists():
   141→            self._log_debug(f"LoRA already present: {target_path}")
   142→            return target_path.resolve()
   143→
   144→        self._log_info(f"Downloading LoRA '{filename}' from '{repo_id}'" +
   145→                       (f" (subfolder: {hf_subfolder})" if hf_subfolder else ""))
   146→        try:
   147→            dl_path = hf_hub_download(
   148→                repo_id=repo_id,
   149→                filename=filename,
   150→                subfolder=hf_subfolder,
   151→                revision="main",
   152→                local_dir=str(self.qwen_lora_dir)
   153→            )
   154→            # If downloaded to a subdirectory, move to flat location
   155→            actual_path = Path(dl_path)
   156→            if actual_path.exists() and actual_path.resolve() != target_path.resolve():
   157→                actual_path.replace(target_path)
   158→            self._log_info(f"Successfully downloaded {filename}")
   159→            return target_path.resolve()
   160→        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
   161→            self._log_warning(f"LoRA download failed for {filename}: {e}")
   162→            return None
   163→
   164→    def _ensure_lora_lists(self, generation_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   165→        """Ensure lora_names and lora_multipliers exist as lists."""
   166→        generation_params.setdefault("lora_names", [])
   167→        generation_params.setdefault("lora_multipliers", [])
   168→
   169→    def _add_lightning_lora(
   170→        self,
   171→        db_task_params: Dict[str, Any],
   172→        generation_params: Dict[str, Any],
   173→        lightning_fname: str = [REDACTED],
   174→        lightning_repo: str = "lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning",
   175→        hf_subfolder: str = None,
   176→        default_phase1: float = 0.85,
   177→        default_phase2: float = 0.0,
   178→    ):
   179→        """Download Lightning LoRA if needed and add to generation params with phase support."""
   180→        self._ensure_lora_lists(generation_params)
   181→
   182→        if not (self.qwen_lora_dir / lightning_fname).exists():
   183→            self._download_lora_if_missing(lightning_repo, lightning_fname, hf_subfolder=hf_subfolder)
   184→
   185→        if lightning_fname in generation_params["lora_names"]:
   186→            return
   187→
   188→        phase1 = float(db_task_params.get("lightning_lora_strength_phase_1", default_phase1))
   189→        phase2 = float(db_task_params.get("lightning_lora_strength_phase_2", default_phase2))
   190→
   191→        generation_params["lora_names"].append(lightning_fname)
   192→        if db_task_params.get("hires_scale") is not None:
   193→            generation_params["lora_multipliers"].append(f"{phase1};{phase2}")
   194→            self._log_info(f"Added Lightning LoRA with strength Phase1={phase1}, Phase2={phase2}")
   195→        else:
   196→            generation_params["lora_multipliers"].append(phase1)
   197→            self._log_info(f"Added Lightning LoRA with strength {phase1}")
   198→
   199→    def _add_lightning_lora_simple(
   200→        self,
   201→        db_task_params: Dict[str, Any],
   202→        generation_params: Dict[str, Any],
   203→        lightning_fname: str = [REDACTED],
   204→        lightning_repo: str = "lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning",
   205→        strength_param: str = "lightning_lora_strength",
   206→        default_strength: float = 0.45,
   207→    ):
   208→        """Download Lightning LoRA if needed and add with a single strength value (no phases)."""
   209→        self._ensure_lora_lists(generation_params)
   210→
   211→        if not (self.qwen_lora_dir / lightning_fname).exists():
   212→            self._download_lora_if_missing(lightning_repo, lightning_fname)
   213→
   214→        if lightning_fname in generation_params["lora_names"]:
   215→            return
   216→
   217→        strength = float(db_task_params.get(strength_param, default_strength))
   218→        generation_params["lora_names"].append(lightning_fname)
   219→        generation_params["lora_multipliers"].append(strength)
   220→        self._log_info(f"Added Lightning LoRA '{lightning_fname}' @ {strength}")
   221→
   222→    def _add_task_lora(self, generation_params: Dict[str, Any], repo_id: str, filename: str, multiplier: float = 1.0):
   223→        """Download and add a task-specific LoRA."""
   224→        self._download_lora_if_missing(repo_id, filename)
   225→        self._ensure_lora_lists(generation_params)
   226→        if filename not in generation_params["lora_names"]:
   227→            generation_params["lora_names"].append(filename)
   228→            generation_params["lora_multipliers"].append(multiplier)
   229→
   230→    def _apply_additional_loras(self, db_task_params: Dict[str, Any], generation_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   231→        """Apply additional LoRAs from task params (loras array or additional_loras dict)."""
   232→        # Handle array format: [{"path": "url", "scale": 0.8}]
   233→        loras = db_task_params.get("loras", [])
   234→        for lora in loras:
   235→            if isinstance(lora, dict):
   236→                path = lora.get("path", "")
   237→                scale = float(lora.get("scale", 1.0))
   238→                if path:
   239→                    if "additional_loras" not in generation_params:
   240→                        generation_params["additional_loras"] = {}
   241→                    generation_params["additional_loras"][path] = scale
   242→                    self._log_debug(f"Added LoRA from array: {path} @ {scale}")
   243→
   244→        # Handle dict format: {"url": scale}
   245→        additional_loras = db_task_params.get("additional_loras", {})
   246→        if additional_loras:
   247→            if "additional_loras" not in generation_params:
   248→                generation_params["additional_loras"] = {}
   249→            generation_params["additional_loras"].update(additional_loras)
   250→            self._log_debug(f"Added {len(additional_loras)} additional LoRAs from dict")
   251→
   252→    # ── Hires fix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   253→
   254→    def _maybe_add_hires_config(self, db_task_params: Dict[str, Any], generation_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   255→        """Add hires_config if hires params are present in task params."""
   256→        hires_scale = db_task_params.get("hires_scale")
   257→        if hires_scale is None:
   258→            return  # No hires fix requested
   259→
   260→        hires_config = {
   261→            "enabled": True,
   262→            "scale": float(hires_scale),
   263→            "hires_steps": int(db_task_params.get("hires_steps", 6)),
   264→            "denoising_strength": float(db_task_params.get("hires_denoise", 0.5)),
   265→            "upscale_method": db_task_params.get("hires_upscale_method", "bicubic"),
   266→        }
   267→        generation_params["hires_config"] = hires_config
   268→
   269→        # Convert LoRA multipliers to phase-based format (pass1;pass2)
   270→        # This allows fine control over which LoRAs are active in each pass
   271→        self._convert_to_phase_multipliers(generation_params)
   272→
   273→        self._log_info(
   274→            f"Hires fix enabled: {hires_config['scale']}x scale, "
   275→            f"{hires_config['hires_steps']} steps @ {hires_config['denoising_strength']} denoise"
   276→        )
   277→
   278→    def _convert_to_phase_multipliers(self, generation_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   279→        """
   280→        Convert simple LoRA multipliers to phase-based format for hires fix.
   281→
   282→        IMPORTANT: This stores the full phase format in hires_config but sends
   283→        only pass 1 values to WGP to avoid conflicts with WGP's phase system.
   284→
   285→        Converts:
   286→          ["1.1", "0.5"] -> ["1.1;1.1", "0.5;0.5"]
   287→
   288→        Where the format is "pass1_strength;pass2_strength".
   289→
   290→        Lightning LoRA phases are manually controlled via:
   291→        - lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 (default: 0.85)
   292→        - lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 (default: 0.0)
   293→
   294→        All other LoRAs -> "X;X" (same strength in both passes unless phase format specified).
   295→        """
   296→        if "lora_multipliers" not in generation_params:
   297→            return
   298→
   299→        lora_names = generation_params.get("lora_names", [])
   300→        multipliers = generation_params["lora_multipliers"]
   301→
   302→        # Ensure multipliers is a list
   303→        if not isinstance(multipliers, list):
   304→            multipliers = [multipliers]
   305→
   306→        # Convert to phase-based format
   307→        # Note: auto_detect_lightning=False because Lightning LoRA phases are now manually specified
   308→        phase_multipliers = format_phase_multipliers(
   309→            lora_names=lora_names,
   310→            multipliers=multipliers,
   311→            num_phases=2,  # Hires fix = 2 passes
   312→            auto_detect_lightning=False  # Manual control via lightning_lora_strength_phase_1/2
   313→        )
   314→
   315→        # Store full phase format AND LoRA names in hires_config for qwen_main.py to use
   316→        if "hires_config" in generation_params:
   317→            generation_params["hires_config"]["lora_names"] = lora_names
   318→            generation_params["hires_config"]["phase_lora_multipliers"] = phase_multipliers
   319→            self._log_info(f"Stored {len(lora_names)} LoRA names and phase multipliers in hires_config")
   320→            for i, (name, mult) in enumerate(zip(lora_names, phase_multipliers)):
   321→                self._log_info(f"   LoRA {i+1}: {name} @ {mult}")
   322→
   323→        # Extract ONLY pass 1 values to send to WGP (avoids conflict with WGP's phase system)
   324→        pass1_multipliers = extract_phase_values(
   325→            phase_multipliers,
   326→            phase_index=0,  # Pass 1
   327→            num_phases=2
   328→        )
   329→
   330→        generation_params["lora_multipliers"] = pass1_multipliers
   331→        self._log_info(f"Sending pass 1 multipliers to WGP: {pass1_multipliers}")
   332→

   492→        generation_params.setdefault("num_inference_steps", 12)
   493→        generation_params.setdefault("video_length", 1)
   494→
   495→        # Set system prompt based on parameters
   496→        custom_prompt = db_task_params.get("system_prompt")
   497→        if custom_prompt:
   498→            generation_params["system_prompt"] = custom_prompt
   499→        else:
   500→            generation_params["system_prompt"] = select_style_system_prompt(
   501→                has_subject=subject_strength > 0,
   502→                has_style=style_strength > 0,
   503→                has_scene=scene_strength > 0,
   504→            )
   505→
   506→        # Lightning LoRA (variant-aware)
   507→        edit_config = self._get_edit_model_config(db_task_params)
   508→        self._add_lightning_lora(
   509→            db_task_params, generation_params,
   510→            lightning_fname=edit_config["lightning_fname"],

   512→            hf_subfolder=edit_config["hf_subfolder"],
   513→            default_phase1=0.85, default_phase2=0.0,
   514→        )
   515→
   516→        # Conditional style/subject/scene LoRAs
   517→        style_fname = "style_transfer_qwen_edit_2_000011250.safetensors"
   518→        subject_fname = "in_subject_qwen_edit_2_000006750.safetensors"
   519→        scene_fname = "in_scene_different_object_000010500.safetensors"
   520→
   521→        if style_strength > 0.0:
   522→            self._add_task_lora(generation_params, "peteromallet/ad_motion_loras", style_fname, style_strength)
   523→        if subject_strength > 0.0:
   524→            self._add_task_lora(generation_params, "peteromallet/mystery_models", subject_fname, subject_strength)
   525→        if scene_strength > 0.0:
   526→            self._add_task_lora(generation_params, "peteromallet/random_junk", scene_fname, scene_strength)
   527→
   528→        # Optional hires fix
   529→        self._maybe_add_hires_config(db_task_params, generation_params)

   531→    def handle_qwen_image_hires(self, db_task_params: Dict[str, Any], generation_params: Dict[str, Any]):
   532→        """
   533→        Handle qwen_image_hires task type - two-pass generation with latent upscaling.
   534→
   535→        Workflow:
   536→        - Pass 1: Generate at base resolution (default 1328x1328)
   537→        - Latent upscale: Bicubic interpolation in latent space
   538→        - Pass 2: Refine at higher resolution with partial denoising
   539→
   540→        This replicates the ComfyUI two-pass hires fix workflow.
   541→        """
   542→        self._log_info("Processing qwen_image_hires task (two-pass generation)")
   543→
   544→        # Default base resolutions matching ComfyUI workflow
   545→        BASE_RESOLUTIONS = {
   546→            "1:1": (1328, 1328),
   547→            "16:9": (1664, 928),
   548→            "9:16": (928, 1664),
   549→            "4:3": (1472, 1104),
   550→            "3:4": (1104, 1472),
   551→            "3:2": (1584, 1056),
   552→            "2:3": (1056, 1584),
   553→        }
   554→
   555→        # Determine base resolution
   556→        resolution_input = db_task_params.get("resolution", "1328x1328")
   557→        if resolution_input in BASE_RESOLUTIONS:
   558→            # Aspect ratio key provided
   559→            w, h = BASE_RESOLUTIONS[resolution_input]
   560→            resolution_str = f"{w}x{h}"
   561→        else:
   562→            resolution_str = resolution_input
   563→
   564→        generation_params["resolution"] = resolution_str
   565→
   566→        # Build hires config

    34→def worker_loop(queue: "HeadlessTaskQueue"):
    35→    """Main worker loop for processing tasks."""
    36→    import threading
    37→    worker_name = threading.current_thread().name
    38→    queue.logger.info(f"{worker_name} started")
    39→
    40→    while queue.running and not queue.shutdown_event.is_set():
    41→        try:
    42→            # Get next task (blocks with timeout)
    43→            try:
    44→                priority, timestamp, task = queue.task_queue.get(timeout=1.0)
    45→            except queue_mod.Empty:
    46→                continue
    47→
    48→            # Process the task
    49→            process_task_impl(queue, task, worker_name)
    50→
    51→        except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:
    52→            queue.logger.error(f"{worker_name} error: {e}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
    53→            time.sleep(1.0)
    54→
    55→    queue.logger.info(f"{worker_name} stopped")
    56→
    57→
    58→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59→# Monitor loop
    60→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61→
    62→def _monitor_loop(queue: "HeadlessTaskQueue"):
    63→    """Background monitoring and maintenance loop."""
    64→    queue.logger.info("Queue monitor started")
    65→
    66→    while queue.running and not queue.shutdown_event.is_set():
    67→        try:
    68→            # Monitor loop placeholder - future home for memory/queue/timeout monitoring
    69→            time.sleep(10.0)  # Monitor every 10 seconds

    71→        except (RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError) as e:
    72→            queue.logger.error(f"Monitor error: {e}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
    73→            time.sleep(5.0)
    74→
    75→    queue.logger.info("Queue monitor stopped")

All call sites use `self._ensure_orchestrator()`, `queue._ensure_orchestrator()`, `task_queue.get_task_status()`, etc. -- they all call these as methods on a `HeadlessTaskQueue` instance. Since the methods are now provided via mixins on the class, all these calls resolve correctly via MRO. No external importers reference these methods by importing them directly from the module; they all access them through the instance.

The `comfy_handler.py` and `comfy_utils.py` references to `wait_for_completion` are unrelated -- they're on a different class (comfy client). The `README.md` reference is just documentation using the method on a queue instance.

Here is a summary of the decomposition:

## Changes Made

### New Files Created

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/Headless-Wan2GP/source/task_handlers/queue/wgp_init.py`** (211 LOC)
- Contains `WgpInitMixin` class with 3 methods:
  - `_ensure_orchestrator()` -- lazy CUDA warmup and orchestrator initialization
  - `_import_and_create_orchestrator()` -- extracted from the inner block of `_ensure_orchestrator` for clarity (handles sys.argv/cwd protection and WanOrchestrator import)
  - `_init_wgp_integration()` -- wgp state integration after orchestrator init
- Contains 2 module-level helper functions:
  - `_log_cuda_available_diagnostics()` -- CUDA diagnostic logging when GPU is available
  - `_log_cuda_unavailable_diagnostics()` -- diagnostic logging when CUDA is unavailable

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/Headless-Wan2GP/source/task_handlers/queue/queue_state.py`** (90 LOC)
- Contains `QueueStateMixin` class with 4 methods:
  - `get_task_status()` -- task status lookup
  - `wait_for_completion()` -- blocking wait with timeout
  - `get_queue_status()` -- queue status snapshot (uses local import for `QueueStatus` to avoid circular dependency)
  - `_get_memory_usage()` -- memory usage stub

### Modified Files

**`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/Headless-Wan2GP/source/task_handlers/queue/task_queue.py`** (725 -> 483 LOC, -33%)
- Added imports for `WgpInitMixin` and `QueueStateMixin`
- Changed class declaration to `HeadlessTaskQueue(WgpInitMixin, QueueStateMixin)`
- Removed 6 methods now provided by mixins
- Removed unused `traceback` import
- `GenerationTask`, `QueueStatus`, and `HeadlessTaskQueue` all remain importable from this module -- no external importer changes needed

### Design Decisions

1. **Mixin pattern** chosen over standalone functions because the extracted methods heavily access `self` attributes (`self.orchestrator`, `self.debug_mode`, `self.logger`, `self.task_history`, `self.queue_lock`, etc.)
2. **Circular dependency** between `queue_state.py` and `task_queue.py` resolved via `TYPE_CHECKING` guard for type hints and a local import inside `get_queue_status()` for the runtime `QueueStatus` constructor
3. **CUDA diagnostic blocks** extracted into module-level helper functions (`_log_cuda_available_diagnostics`, `_log_cuda_unavailable_diagnostics`) to reduce nesting depth in `_ensure_orchestrator`
4. **Unused variable** `_saved_cwd` (originally line 309) was correctly omitted since it was never used

   247→                _old_module_image_save_path = getattr(wgp, 'image_save_path', 'NOT_SET')
   248→
   249→                # Update the dictionary (for consistency)
   250→                wgp.server_config['save_path'] = absolute_outputs_path
   251→                wgp.server_config['image_save_path'] = absolute_outputs_path
   252→
   253→                # Update the module-level variables (this is what wgp.py actually uses!)
   254→                wgp.save_path = absolute_outputs_path
   255→                wgp.image_save_path = absolute_outputs_path
   256→
   257→                model_logger.info(f"[OUTPUT_DIR] BEFORE: dict={{save_path={_old_dict_save_path}, image_save_path={_old_dict_image_save_path}}}, module={{save_path={_old_module_save_path}, image_save_path={_old_module_image_save_path}}}")
   258→                model_logger.info(f"[OUTPUT_DIR] AFTER:  dict={{save_path={wgp.server_config['save_path']}, image_save_path={wgp.server_config['image_save_path']}}}, module={{save_path={wgp.save_path}, image_save_path={wgp.image_save_path}}}")
   259→                
   260→                # Debug: Check if model definitions are loaded
   261→                if debug_mode:
   262→                    model_logger.info(f"[INIT_DEBUG] Available models after WGP import: {list(wgp.models_def.keys())}")
   263→                _verify_wgp_directory(model_logger, "after wgp setup and monkeypatching")
   264→
   265→                if not wgp.models_def:
   266→                    error_msg = (
   267→                        f"CRITICAL: No model definitions found after importing wgp! "
   268→                        f"Current directory: {os.getcwd()}, "
   269→                        f"Expected: {self.wan_root}, "
   270→                        f"defaults/ exists: {os.path.exists('defaults')}, "
   271→                        f"finetunes/ exists: {os.path.exists('finetunes')}"
   272→                    )
   273→                    model_logger.error(error_msg)
   274→                    raise RuntimeError(error_msg)
   275→            except ImportError as e:
   276→                raise ImportError(f"Failed to import wgp module. Ensure {wan_root} contains wgp.py: {e}")
   277→            finally:
   278→                try:
   279→                    sys.argv = _saved_argv
   280→                except (TypeError, ValueError) as e:
   281→                    _init_logger.debug("Failed to restore sys.argv after wgp import: %s", e)
   282→
   283→        # Initialize state object (mimics UI state)

   285→            "generation": {},
   286→            "model_type": None,
   287→            "model_filename": "",
   288→            "advanced": False,
   289→            "last_model_per_family": {},
   290→            "last_resolution_per_group": {},
   291→            "gen": {
   292→                "queue": [],
   293→                "file_list": [],
   294→                "file_settings_list": [],
   295→                "audio_file_list": [],
   296→                "audio_file_settings_list": [],
   297→                "selected": 0,
   298→                "prompt_no": 1,
   299→                "prompts_max": 1
   300→            },
   301→            "loras": [],
   302→            "loras_names": [],
   303→            "loras_presets": {},
   304→            # Additional state properties to prevent future KeyErrors
   305→            "validate_success": 1,      # Required for validation checks
   306→            "apply_success": 1,         # Required for settings application  
   307→            "refresh": None,            # Required for UI refresh operations

   310→            "prompt": ""               # Required for prompt handling

   312→        
   313→        # Apply sensible defaults (mirrors typical UI defaults)
   314→        if not self.smoke_mode:
   315→            # Ensure model_type is set before applying config, as upstream generate_header/get_overridden_attention
   316→            # will look up the current model's definition via state["model_type"].
   317→            try:
   318→                import wgp as _w
   319→                default_model_type = getattr(_w, "transformer_type", None) or "t2v"
   320→            except (ImportError, AttributeError):
   321→                default_model_type = "t2v"
   322→            self.state["model_type"] = default_model_type
   323→
   324→            # Upstream apply_changes signature accepts a single save_path_choice
   325→            outputs_dir = "outputs/"
   326→            try:
   327→                orchestrator_logger.debug("Calling wgp.apply_changes() to initialize defaults...")
   328→                self._apply_changes(
   329→                    self.state,
   330→                    transformer_types_choices=["t2v"],
   331→                    transformer_dtype_policy_choice="auto",
   332→                    text_encoder_quantization_choice="bf16",
   333→                    VAE_precision_choice="fp32",
   334→                    mixed_precision_choice=0,
   335→                    save_path_choice=outputs_dir,
   336→                    image_save_path_choice=outputs_dir,
   337→                    attention_choice="auto",
   338→                    compile_choice="",
   339→                    profile_choice=1,  # Profile 1 for 24GB+ VRAM (4090/3090)
   340→                    vae_config_choice="default",
   341→                    metadata_choice="none",
   342→                    quantization_choice="int8",
   343→                    preload_model_policy_choice=[]
   344→                )
   345→                orchestrator_logger.debug("wgp.apply_changes() completed successfully")
   346→            except (RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as e:
   347→                orchestrator_logger.error(f"❌ FATAL: wgp.apply_changes() failed: {e}\n{traceback.format_exc()}")
   348→                raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to apply WGP defaults during orchestrator init: {e}") from e
   349→
   350→            # Verify directory after apply_changes (it may have done file operations)
   351→            _verify_wgp_directory(orchestrator_logger, "after apply_changes()")
   352→
   353→            # CRITICAL: apply_changes() reads from server_config dict back into module-level vars
   354→            # So we must set our output paths AGAIN after apply_changes() completes!
   355→            orchestrator_logger.info(f"[OUTPUT_DIR] Reapplying output directory configuration after apply_changes()...")
   356→            wgp.server_config['save_path'] = absolute_outputs_path
   357→            wgp.server_config['image_save_path'] = absolute_outputs_path
   358→            wgp.save_path = absolute_outputs_path
   359→            wgp.image_save_path = absolute_outputs_path
   360→            orchestrator_logger.info(f"[OUTPUT_DIR] Final check: dict={{save_path={wgp.server_config['save_path']}, image_save_path={wgp.server_config['image_save_path']}}}, module={{save_path={wgp.save_path}, image_save_path={wgp.image_save_path}}}")
   361→
   362→        else:
   363→            # Provide stubbed helpers for smoke mode
   364→            self._get_base_model_type = lambda model_key: ("t2v" if "flux" not in (model_key or "") else "flux")
   365→            self._get_model_family = lambda model_key, for_ui=False: ("VACE" if "vace" in (model_key or "") else ("Flux" if "flux" in (model_key or "") else "T2V"))

   367→        self.current_model = None
   368→        self.offloadobj = None  # Store WGP's offload object

   370→        self._cached_uni3c_controlnet = None  # Cached Uni3C ControlNet to avoid reloading from disk
   371→
   372→        orchestrator_logger.success(f"WanOrchestrator initialized with WGP at {wan_root}")

   374→        # Final notice for smoke mode
   375→        if self.smoke_mode:
   376→            orchestrator_logger.warning("HEADLESS_WAN2GP_SMOKE enabled: generation will return sample outputs only")
